a horizontal dividing band/line separating zones of imagery

justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry schematic low-relief imagery organised into stacked horizontal registers separated by a plain dividing line, with repeated profile motifs in a row. What is actually depicted differs entirely: A shows a single large frontal/standing anthropomorphic figure with an elaborate headdress accompanied by rectangular glyph-like blocks, while B shows rows of small profile animals (bird-like forms above, quadruped/serpentine forms below) with no human figure or script-like signs.
